title: Exploring DP-CGANS
summary: A research repository that profiles and tries to speed up the DP-CGAN differentially-private GAN package for synthetic tabular data, including adapting its Bayesian Gaussian Mixture Model component for use with the TAPAS privacy-attack toolbox. DP-CGAN is itself built by extending SDV and CTGAN, and profiling traces from running the training/sampling scripts show SDV's CTGANSynthesizer, TVAESynthesizer and sdv/tabular/base.py classes actually executing at runtime.
evidence: profiling_output/nobs_10000_snellius.txt:193 shows calls into sdv/tabular/base.py and ctgan TVAESynthesizer/CTGANSynthesizer during dp_cgans profiling
needs: SDV/CTGAN/RDT appear pinned in pyproject.toml and are exercised via the dp_cgans dependency; unclear if this repo's own code calls sdv/ctgan/rdt APIs directly beyond profiling the installed packages used by dp_cgans.
